faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our pricing.
faq.q1: Can I try Clausent for free?
faq.a1: Yes! You can analyze your first contract completely free, no credit card required. After that, choose a plan that fits your needs.
faq.q2: What happens if I exceed my contract limit?
faq.a2: You'll receive a notification when you're near your limit. You can upgrade your plan at any time to add more contracts. Existing contracts remain accessible.
faq.q3: Can I switch plans at any time?
faq.a3: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. When upgrading, you'll be charged the prorated difference. When downgrading, the change takes effect at the next billing cycle.
faq.q4: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faq.a4: Yes, you save 20% when you choose annual billing. The discount is applied automatically when you toggle to annual pricing.
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) and ACH bank transfers for annual plans. Enterprise customers can also pay via invoice.
faq.a6: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee on all plans. If you're not satisfied, contact our support team for a full refund.

about.title: About Clausent
about.subtitle: We're on a mission to save small businesses money on their contracts.
about.missionDescription: Every year, SMBs lose billions of dollars on auto-renewed contracts, unfavorable terms, and missed renegotiation opportunities. Clausent uses AI to change that.
about.teamTitle: Built by a Team That Cares

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using Clausent.
terms.section1Content: By accessing or using the Clausent platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.
terms.section2Content: Clausent provides AI-powered contract analysis, risk scoring, renewal alerts, and renegotiation support for businesses.
terms.section3Content: You must provide accurate information when creating an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.
terms.section4Content: You may not use Clausent for any unlawful purpose, to transmit malicious content, or to attempt to access other users' data.

terms.section7Content: Clausent shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the service.
terms.section8Content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via email or in-app notification.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy describes how Clausent collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.section1Content: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, payment info) and data generated through your use of our services (contract uploads, analysis results).
privacy.section2Content: We use your data to provide and improve our services, process payments, send notifications, and communicate with you about your account.
privacy.section3Content: Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Contract files are stored securely on AWS S3 with strict access controls. We never share your contract data with third parties.
privacy.section4Content: Contract analysis is performed by our AI engine. Your contract data is processed solely to provide analysis results and is not used to train AI models.
privacy.section5Content: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Upon account deletion, your data is permanently removed within 30 days.
privacy.section6Content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You may also request a copy of your data in a portable format.
privacy.section7Content: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use tracking cookies or sell your data to advertisers.
privacy.section8Content: For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@clausent.com.
